observations: The page number «103» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 102 (JP2 0134, L39), «Also erst nach». A wider space stands before the heading L16.

L01-L02. Checked: 9d 1h 5m are the excess of 35 years of al-Khwārizmī over 35 years of 365 days (p. 102, JP2 0134). The example of p. 102 counts from 4 January 962 to 4 January 997, 35 × 365 days and the 9 Julian leap days; counted from the same hour of 4 January 997, the 35th birthday of the Julian calendar, the sun returns to its place after 1h 5m; the 9d 1h 5m run from the end of 35 years of 365 days, 26 December 996, to the same moment. L09-L10 call the year of 365 days «das bürgerliche».

L09-L15 and N02. Checked: 93° 2′ 15″ at 15° to the hour are 6h 12m 9s, and 93° 2′ 15″ : 360° = 0.2584375 days, Brahmagupta's year of 365.2584375 days (1 577 916 450 000 days in 4 320 000 000 years); the 6h 13m 2s are the year derived from the hourly mean motion of the sun on p. 65 (JP2 0097), «ungefähr dieselbe Grösse, die wir oben (p. 42) gefunden haben». The value 93° 2′ 15″ of Table 115 is to be compared with the table.

L03-L04 and N01. Checked against Nallino: I, 148 is al-Battānī's chapter on the revolutions of the years by the tables, which asks for «locum medium et locum verum Solis in origine»; I, 304-305 is Nallino's note on the revolutions of the nativities.
L16-L17: the heading of the second closing chapter, in bold, centred, with the reference to the table below it in smaller type.

L23-L37. Checked: the houses of Mars are Aries and Scorpio, of Venus Taurus and Libra, the sun and the moon one each; the sign opposite a house is the detriment: Libra and Taurus being the houses of Venus, Aries and Scorpio are her detriments; Aries and Scorpio being those of Mars, Libra and Taurus are his, as L36-L37 say. The columns of Table 116 are to be compared with the table.
L04: after «eintreten,» a small arc below the line (17 px), spacing material inked; not transcribed. L15: «sein. 2)», the note number after a space following the full stop.

L29: «ṣāḥib», with the dots under the s and the h and the macron over the a; L32: «wabāl», with the macron. L06: «Minuten und Sekunden an. — Diese», the long dash with a space on either side; L29 «Venus. — Diese»; N01 «304—305», set close.
